independent.method: Exact-source species probe plus independent CLI scope adjudication; subsequent preparse design probe found hidden descriptor recursion gap.

findings: Array map consults caller-controlled species constructors
Compaction serializes records mutated by its selection callback without revalidation
Known-field accessors and root proxies can execute before Zod metadata refinements
Symbol-keyed executable descriptors are omitted from the guard
Boxed String/Number values with reset prototypes can coerce to unsafe serialized content
Hidden data properties can hide nested executable values from preparse recursion
resolution: Candidate copies fresh arrays; checks all descriptors including symbols/hidden values; rejects boxed primitives; guards append/audit/local-coordination before property reads; wraps both owned ledger schema entrypoints before Zod type inspection; revalidates and bounds compaction records before publication. Invocation and byte-preservation regressions cover each finding. Renewed exact-head review required.

gemini_classification_dissent.finding: route-task latestClassification ignores explicit session scope
gemini_classification_dissent.basis: Selector is unchanged from main and selects limit_classification by explicit classificationTaskId or taskId. sessionContinuation is boolean portability preference, not identity. Earlier DATA repair concerns replaySession route_decision scope. Bypassing the task filter would admit unrelated classifications. Independent review separately confirms this distinction. COORD owns routing/classification policy.

suggestions_disposition.scanner_cost: Non-blocking quadratic URL pattern/late text sizing noted; finite policy and payload limits do not claim constant scanner latency. No acceptance speed threshold. INTEG owns bounded composition.
suggestions_disposition.unusual_ancestor_permissions: Writable but unreadable or immutable ancestors may fail explicitly; supported successful publication requires readable writable directories for fsync.
suggestions_disposition.nonobject_partial_roots: Non-blocking; demonstrably truncated JSON bytes retained privately before repair under existing frozen tail rule.
suggestions_disposition.writer_manifest_size: Non-blocking private-root writer manifest read; bounded visible snapshot contract unchanged.
